PLAY AVIATOR WITH HOLLYWOODBETS Aviator is a simple game. Pick your bet amount (stake) and wait for the game round to start. The game round gets underway when the plane takes off. As the plane climbs, the on-screen multiplier will increase. Your job is simple: hold your nerve and hit the cash out button before the plane flies off the screen. Cash out in time and you will win – (stake x multiplier at the time you cashed out = winnings) . If you fail to cash out in time you will lose your bet. How to Play Aviator You’re going to need to register for a Hollywoodbets account before you hit the runway. Once you’ve registered through the boarding gates, you’re ready for take-off. Aviator requires almost no skill, uses very little data, and has flights taking off 24/7. So how do you play? The first thing to remember is that the game takes place in two states: the betting round and the game round . The first step? Place your bet before the plane takes off. You will know to do so because the green “BET” buttons at the bottom of the screen will be green, and the game will display a message reading “WAITING FOR NEXT ROUND”. This is the betting round . The game round begins when the plane takes off. The multiplier will appear on screen at this point and will continue to increase as the plane climbs. Your goal is to cash your bet out before the plane flies off the screen. To do so, click on the orange “CASH OUT” button. You’ll know you’ve cashed out in time because a green field will appear at the top of the screen displaying the multiplier at the time of cash out along with the amount won. Remember: (stake x multiplier = winnings). Your bet will lose if the plane flies off the screen before you are able to cash out. PLAY NOW Key Features that Soar Above the Rest Aviator’s appeal lies in its simplicity, but it is still packed full of features that help enhance your experience. In-Game Chat: The in-game chat is one of Aviator’s best features. It allows you to interact and socialise with other players. Think of it as a giant WhatsApp group filled with everyone playing the game at the moment. The best part? Big wins are automatically posted here by the game. So if someone scores a R100,000 win off a R10 stake, the game will post the win onto the pink background. Game Statistics Aviator boasts a comprehensive suite of game statistics. You can see all of the bets placed by other players in a game round. You can also see some of the day’s, month’s, or year’s biggest winners broken down by “Huge Wins”, “Biggest Wins”, and “Multipliers”. Auto Play: This takes a lot of the guesswork and emotion out of your Aviator experience. It lets you set the game up to bet the same amount at the start of each new game. The auto cash out feature allows you to cash your bets out once the multiplier reaches a predetermined threshold. You can also fully automate the entire experience from placing the bet to cashing out. Aviator also allows you to set win-loss limits, putting you firmly in control even when the game is set to auto play.
